title: Hybrid Blanket
hero: An interactive blanket pattern designed to combine two stitch patterns or knitting methods with different gauges.
excerpt: Combine hand and machine knitting — or mix stitch patterns for borders and body — without doing any math and without distorted edges.
metaTitle: Hybrid Blanket Pattern – Combine Two Stitch Patterns
metaDescription: Create a blanket that combines two stitch patterns or knitting methods with different gauges. The pattern handles stitch counts and transitions for you.
